case.title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG. Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor. Need: 6110 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 36 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200002. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for setting out your cost structure so clearly. We value our cooperation and take the copper situation seriously.

Our data shows a different picture on one point:

Your quality was 273 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70510@2026Q3).

We would still like to meet you on other terms. The options below are structured so you can take them straight to your pricing committee, and we are glad to provide any further information the approval needs.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 358.48; payment 45 days net; no index clause.
Option B: unit price EUR 355.81; payment 60 days net; index clause on CU-NOTATION (20 % material share, deadband 5 %, base 2026-08).
Option C: unit price EUR 358.41; payment 14 days net; no index clause.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have carefully reviewed your proposed options and prefer to proceed without an index clause to ensure administrative efficiency. While we acknowledge your quality data, please note that the reported figures remain strictly within our agreed target limits and do not warrant a price reduction. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot is a price of €355.81 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION. This offer remains valid for 30 days. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Quality Management: We meet the agreed quality targets.
